highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It adds variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, a Graphite-ready singleton lifecycle rework, and new Vulkan interop types, alongside several native dependency updates. This is a breaking release — read the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped and lost value-equality
breaking.body: The property is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (was GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo), and the type no longer implements IEquatable or the == / != operators. Compare fields directly instead of using equality operators.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its setter
breaking.body: The property is now get-only. Code that assigned it must remove the assignment; the value is now controlled internally.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface instead of a lazy default
breaking.body: new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty instead of null, so MeasureText on an unset font returns 0. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) to get the old behavior, and check font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of comparing to null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns Default instead of null
breaking.body: Text still draws and measures correctly, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect an unset typeface no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty, or drop the check since a usable default is always present.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName never returns null, even on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now consistently fall back to SKTypeface.Default for an unmatched family name. For a strict "was it found" check, call SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) instead, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload previously silently truncated offsets larger than int.MaxValue; it now throws OverflowException for out-of-range values and is marked [Obsolete] (CS0618). Call Move(int) with an in-range, validated offset instead.

bullets.detail: Moves through Skia milestones 132, 133, and 147 before landing on m148, merging several rounds of upstream bug fixes along the way.

bullets.lead: Variable and color font support added
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette support and improved variable font robustness.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream access
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP, and SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz HBColor struct and API cleanup
bullets.detail: Adds an HBColor struct for hb_color_t, plus missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes.

bullets.lead: Legacy paint/text obsoletes promoted to errors
bullets.detail: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs, including legacy paint text/font state members, are now compile errors rather than warnings.
SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the generic offset overload.
Fixes a crash when SKPathBuilder is garbage-collected before the SKPath it produced.
Fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers, and SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI's TabBar.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.

bullets.lead: New native targets and TFM fixes
bullets.detail: Adds Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native asset support, drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten/WASM, and fixes Apple TFMs to use 26.0 for libraries and unversioned TFMs for apps.
Updates zlib, libpng, libexpat/expat, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to their latest patched versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped Skia to milestones 132/147, added variable font support, reworked the singleton lifecycle, fixed the SKPathBuilder finalizer crash, promoted legacy paint obsoletes to errors, moved default-typeface resolution to the managed layer, and modernized SkiaSharpGenerator for Linux.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native asset support and enabled PolySharp for C# 13 on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Reduced the SkiaFiddle WASM sample application's size by roughly 60%.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the README.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch in MAUI's TabBar.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line, bumping Skia to milestone 132 and adding early TFM, Tizen, and PolySharp platform support.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added variable font support, color font palettes, and the animated WebP encoder, plus a round of native dependency updates.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 bumped Skia to milestone 147, reworked the singleton lifecycle, and promoted the remaining legacy paint/text obsoletes to compile errors.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate bumped Skia to milestone 148, fixed the pixel-access and WinUI/MAUI rendering bugs, and hardened CI ahead of shipping the stable v4 release.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds an HBColor struct for proper color representation, variable-font shaping support, missing API wrappers, and naming-convention fixes, while bumping the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.0.
